research.methodology: US App Store written reviews only. A review is eligible only when its stated app version exactly matches the latest US App Store version checked on 26 October 2026. Previous-version reviews are excluded from every published concern and example. Source dates use the calendar date in Apple’s supplied review-update timestamp; raw timestamps are retained. Storefront territory does not establish reviewer residence.
research.reviewStatus: Attributed current-version user reports; the alleged behavior and its resolution have not been independently reproduced. The source feed omits developer replies.
research.selectionPolicy: Only exact current-version matches are eligible. Selected examples concern specific advertising, input or feature-access issues and retain source IDs, dates, ratings and version metadata. An absent eligible example supplies no adverse inference.
research.scope: US storefront; latest listed version for each app; first review-feed page sorted mostRecent; previous-version entries excluded from published examples.

apps.name: Unit Converter - Best Unit App
apps.reportedConcern: Selected October 2026 reviews of version 10.2 report full-screen ads or advertising obstructing input.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Conversion Calculator Plus documents no full-page ads; the free version uses banners. This directly addresses the full-screen interruption concern. Premium removes banners.
apps.limitations: These reports describe selected sessions. Overall ad frequency and present-day input layout have not been independently measured.
apps.developerAndReleaseContext: Included examples identify version 10.2, matching the latest US App Store version checked on 26 October 2026. The review feed does not include developer replies; no resolution of these selected reports has been independently confirmed.

examples.paraphrase: Reported full-screen advertising and frustration with feature paywalls.

examples.quote: Now the ads cover up the keyboard.

apps.name: Unit Converter - Convert all
apps.reportedConcern: A review identifying current version 3.0.29 reports difficulty entering an inch fraction and dissatisfaction with paid access to less-used conversions.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Conversion Calculator Plus supports division expressions such as 1 ÷ 8 before conversion. Its ordinary measurement categories are not listed as Premium requirements.
apps.limitations: The competing app also advertises an expression calculator. This report does not establish that division is unavailable or that either app has exclusive arithmetic capabilities.
apps.developerAndReleaseContext: Included examples identify version 3.0.29, matching the latest US App Store version checked on 26 October 2026. The review feed does not include developer replies; no resolution of these selected reports has been independently confirmed.

apps.name: Convert Any Unit Lite
apps.reportedConcern: Selected July and September 2026 reviews of version 6.8 report intrusive ads interrupting conversion or unit selection.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: The published no-full-page-ad policy offers a concrete alternative to full-screen interruptions. Premium removes its banner ads.
apps.limitations: The free version of Conversion Calculator Plus still has banners. These individual reports do not establish an overall failure rate or the behavior of every rival session.

apps.name: GlobeConvert Currency & Units
apps.reportedConcern: Selected August and October 2026 reviews of version 2.2.8 criticize lengthy or recurring ads.
apps.ourDocumentedResponse: Conversion Calculator Plus documents no full-page ads. Currency+ also checks rates every minute while active and connected, versus GlobeConvert’s stated hourly updates.
apps.limitations: The reports do not establish which actions triggered each ad. Both products offer saved-rate offline use and an ad-free paid option.
